frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: About card showing branding logo, version info, description, and founder details with theme-aware logo switching.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Backup/restore card allowing exporting state to JSON and importing backups with confirmation and error handling.

frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings, permission requests, category toggles, and test notifications.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: Allows users to edit and validate their profile display name with save and cancel controls.

frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Offers theme mode and color variant selection for app appearance settings.

frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu for subject-specific actions including edit, reset, and delete.

frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo and loading indicators with theme‑aware icon selection.

frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Holds branding constants and helpers for selecting light/dark logo assets.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides common utilities for classes, IDs, dates, and color selection.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Generates notification titles and bodies for class marking actions.
